statement: The complete record has eight distinct fields and 28 pairwise distinctions. Patient report alone never establishes objective physiology. Objective biomarker, comparator, expectation, allocation/blinding, intervention, adverse/absence rows and bounded follow-up are mandatory retained records.
title: Objective physiology and report separation
